findings.title: Password form submits over plain HTTP
findings.remediation: Serve the form and submit credentials only over HTTPS.

findings.title: HTTPS is not available
findings.evidence: SSLError: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='127.0.0.1', port=8767): Max retries exceeded with url: / (Caused by SSLError(SSLError(1, '[SSL: WRONG_VERSION_NUMBER] wrong version number (_ssl.c:992)')))
findings.remediation: Enable HTTPS with a valid certificate.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy header is missing
findings.evidence: Response headers for http://127.0.0.1:8767: content-length, content-type, date, last-modified, server
findings.remediation: Add a strict Content-Security-Policy to reduce XSS and injection risk.

findings.title: Client error (HTTP 404)
findings.remediation: Fix the broken page or update links pointing to it.

findings.title: Broken internal resource
findings.remediation: Fix the missing resource (image/script/style) or update its reference.

findings.title: Broken or unloaded images
findings.remediation: Fix image paths or serve valid image files.

findings.title: Login form has no visible CSRF token
findings.evidence: Form action: http://127.0.0.1:8767/login, fields: username, password
findings.remediation: Add and validate an anti-CSRF token for state-changing and authentication forms.

findings.title: X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors protection is missing
findings.evidence: Response headers for http://127.0.0.1:8767: content-length, content-type, date, last-modified, server
findings.remediation: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY/SAMEORIGIN or CSP frame-ancestors to prevent clickjacking.

findings.title: Accessibility issues found
findings.evidence: 1 image(s) without alt text; 2 form field(s) without an associated label; 1 link(s) without accessible text; duplicate id attribute(s): duplicate
findings.remediation: Fix labels, alt text, accessible link names and duplicate IDs.

findings.title: Server version disclosed
findings.remediation: Remove version details from the Server header.

findings.title: Console error in browser
findings.evidence: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (File not found)
findings.remediation: Fix JavaScript errors reported in the browser console.
